runner_decision_checklist.headline: What to know before you head to Camp Arrowwood.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A runner checklist for pickup, parking, terrain, and registration.

items.label: Packet pickup
items.detail: Packet pickup is listed as day-of only and ends 20 minutes before each race start; pickup is at the shelter near the start/finish and restrooms.

items.label: Parking
items.detail: Use available lots at the tennis courts, main office, and surrounding areas; attendants will direct traffic to available parking.

items.label: Terrain
items.detail: The 5K stays on Camp Arrowwood property and uses rolling access roads with about 90% gravel and less than 10% grass.

items.label: Registration
items.value: Open through race day on RunSignup
items.detail: RunSignup lists registration ending October 17, 2026 at 11:59 PM EDT. Check the official page before registering.

story.title: A fall race morning across Camp Arrowwood.
paragraphs: Camp Arrowwood opens its Wears Valley campus for a fall race morning in Sevier County, with the 5K Run and Kids 1-mile Run centered on the camp property.
The 5K course is listed as two loops on camp access roads, staying on property with rolling/hilly terrain, nearly all gravel roads, and a small amount of grass.
After the race, RunSignup describes post-race festivities with farm animals, music, outdoor camp games, s’mores around the campfire, the campus store, and raffle giveaways.
story.quote: All proceeds for this event will directly benefit Camp Arrowwood missions.

faqs.question: Where is the race?
faqs.answer: The race is at Camp Arrowwood, 100 One Fine Place, Wears Valley, TN 37862.

faqs.question: What is packet pickup?
faqs.answer: Packet pickup is day-of only at the shelter near the start/finish and restrooms, ending 20 minutes before the race is set to start.

faqs.question: What is the course like?
faqs.answer: The 5K stays on Camp Arrowwood property and uses two loops on access roads with rolling/hilly terrain, about 90% gravel and less than 10% grass.

faqs.question: Are there awards?
faqs.answer: RunSignup lists awards for the top male and female 5K finishers plus the top two runners in each age category: 14 & Under, 15–25, 25–44, and 45+.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy?
faqs.answer: RunSignup has a dedicated refund policy page for this race; check the official page for current policy details.

faqs.question: Is there a training resource?
faqs.answer: The RunSignup page links to Knoxville Endurance as a training resource for runners preparing for this race.
